summary: Items 1-13, 15 and 16 are done. Item 14 was skipped as the brief said. Generation settings that offer a list now accept only listed values. Free-text settings go through the content policy when a draft is made, derived or published. Character references now reach the provider with role "reference". If the photo's consent was withdrawn, the job fails and credits come back. Replicate refuses a reference it can't take instead of dropping it. A fault while storing outputs now fails the job, refunds it and removes the files. A failed enqueue no longer fails confirm. Drafts unconfirmed after 24 hours are closed. Remix and Reuse settings now record lineage and keep template attribution while the template can still be used. Suspension unpublishes the account's templates. Account deletion erases the date of birth. Migration 0003 adds five SET NULL foreign keys and cleans dangling references first. Video uploads lose their container metadata. In the create panel: a new idempotency key for any change to the request, the draft's own model and character in the confirm sheet, presets while composing, Atmosphere outside Studio, field hints, upload warnings shown as notes, and Make/Confirm disabled offline. Library Retry now asks you to confirm the cost first. Failed actions show toasts. Train, Policies and seed copy now say what the app actually does.

docsNotes:
Settings: cameraMovement, pacing, lighting and framing accept only the registry lists (CAMERA_MOVEMENTS, PACINGS, LIGHTINGS, FRAMINGS). Anything else gets 422 invalid_input "One of these settings isn't offered (<field>). Pick it again and retry.", including derive from an older job. Every string setting (atmosphere, max 80) goes through checkPrompt with the prompt and negative prompt at draft and derive (422 policy_blocked plus a moderation event). Publish also checks the job's negative prompt and string settings.
Character reference: allowed only with reference_guided. Any other mode gets 422 input_unexpected. The worker sends the photo as ProviderInput role "reference" only while the reference isn't deleted, its consent isn't withdrawn and the photo scanned clean. Otherwise the job fails invalid_input and is refunded. Demo blends the photo under the watermark; this is not a likeness match. Replicate fails "unsupported" when the model has no reference field. Clips can't use a character reference; the panel says so. Nothing is trained on references (Policies has a new Training section).
Replicate flux: lighting/framing/atmosphere (and pacing for video) are appended to the prompt as words unless the prompt already names them. The demo ignores them.
Processor: a fault while storing outputs fails the job as "internal", refunds it and purges the files and asset rows it wrote. If enqueue fails at confirm, the job stays queued with credits held and confirm still succeeds. reconcile re-enqueues it after about 2 minutes.
Drafts: confirm and cancel ignore deleted jobs (404). A draft cancelled before it started gives 409 draft_closed on confirm. reconcile closes awaiting_confirmation drafts older than 24h (DRAFT_TTL_MS): status cancelled, failureCode draft_expired, deletedAt set, no credits involved. It returns expiredDrafts.
Create panel: a new idempotency key whenever the request changes (src/lib/draft-key.ts). If a reused key returns a non-awaiting draft, the panel retries once with a fresh key. The confirm sheet shows the draft's model, its character, and a demo likeness note. "Start from preset" is offered on /generate and Studio, not on template pages or remixes. "Save as preset" is shown when signed in and the template isn't VIP-locked; the seed is never saved (server strips it too). Atmosphere is now outside Studio. Field hints are added. Server upload warnings show as notes: low_resolution warns, scan_pending blocks Make. Make and Confirm are disabled offline.
Copilot: when the prompt names a lighting or framing look and the setting is unset, it offers that setting (info). When the setting names a different look, it warns.
Remix/Reuse (?from=): sends parentJobId, relation remix, the template (only while published or your own, and if VIP only with a pass) and the character (only while on file). The seed is kept only with reuse=exact.
Library Retry: derive, then a cost sheet, then confirm. No more one-tap charge. Creation detail and Library show toasts for failed cancel, favorite, folder add and folder create.
Suspension: same transaction sets user suspended, unpublishes their published templates, and audits the count. The function returns {unpublishedTemplates}; the API route still returns {ok:true}.
Account deletion: date_of_birth set to NULL. age_assured_at/method kept. Migration 0003 makes the column nullable, backfills NULL for deleted users, nulls dangling references, then adds SET NULL FKs on credit_ledger.payment_event_id, generation_jobs.parent_job_id, scene_versions.parent_version_id, templates.remixed_from_id, user_profiles.avatar_asset_id.
Video uploads: rewritten by ffmpeg with -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 -c copy before storage and scan. Unreadable gives 415 unsupported_type; missing ffmpeg gives 503 video_processing_unavailable.
Seed: templates tagged sample, description says the cover is an illustration, generation_count 0.
Policies: private links are signed after an ownership check, last 5 minutes by default (MEDIA_URL_TTL_S) and work for anyone holding them until they expire.
Creation page: links to a project only if not deleted, to a template only if not deleted.
